entry.title: New: RES24-002 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF LODGING VALUED AT $513.57 TO THE CITY FROM THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION (USDOT) FEDERAL TRANSIT ADMINISTRATION (FTA) FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION SERVICES’ DIRECTOR OF RAPID TRANSIT TO ATTEND THE FTA TRANSIT ADVISORY COMMITTEE FOR SAFETY (TRACS) MEETING IN WASHINGTON, DC, DECEMBER 6-7, 2023.

Latest action: Committee report and Resolution were adopted.
